const projects = $('Split Plane projects').all();
return $input.all().map((item, index) => ({ json: { project: projects[index].json, workItemsResponse: item.json } }));

const priors = $('Wrap Plane work items').all();
return $input.all().map((item, index) => ({ json: { ...priors[index].json, cyclesResponse: item.json } }));

const priors = $('Select current Plane cycle').all();
return $input.all().map((item, index) => ({ json: { ...priors[index].json, cycleItemsResponse: item.json } }));

const priors = $('Wrap Plane cycle items').all();
return $input.all().map((item, index) => ({ json: { ...priors[index].json, statesResponse: item.json } }));

const priors = $('Wrap Plane states').all();
return $input.all().map((item, index) => ({ json: { ...priors[index].json, pagesResponse: item.json } }));
